### Non-Obvious Logic Notes

1. **Collaborators vs. Assigned Agent:** The primary assigned agent (Matt Ryan) does NOT appear in the Collaborators picker list. The picker only shows other agents in the same FUB account. This means the data model has both a `assigned_agent_id` field (single) AND a `collaborators` many-to-many join table.

2. **Campaign email tracking:** The "archived" status in the timeline is not the contact's stage — it is the status of the campaign email send (FUB campaigns mark emails as "archived" after a certain state). The body preview shows a pixel tracking URL (`?_pxl=...`), which is how FUB tracks email opens without requiring the recipient to click a link.

3. **"2 opens" badge:** The open count badge (green pill) only appears when `openCount > 0`. When zero, no badge is shown (confirmed by the other three entries having no badge).

4. **"via automation" tag on timeline entries:** This inline source label distinguishes automation-triggered emails from manually sent ones. In manual sends, this would likely show "via Matt Ryan" or similar, or have no source tag.

5. **Keyboard navigation:** The arrow-key navigation hint at the bottom of the right sidebar is a global FUB convention on People detail pages. The page pre-fetches adjacent contact records for instant navigation without full page reload [INFERRED].

6. **Automations badge count:** The "(1)" count after "Automations" in the widget card header reflects the number of active/running automations for this contact. It is dynamically computed.

7. **Modal trigger:** The Collaborators widget "+' button in the right sidebar opens the Collaborators modal. The modal could also be accessible by expanding the Collaborators section and then clicking an "Add" or "Edit" control within the expanded section [INFERRED].

8. **Empty Collaborators section:** Since the Collaborators widget is collapsed in the background and the modal shows no pre-checked items, this contact currently has NO collaborators assigned — only Matt Ryan as the primary agent.

9. **Search field auto-focus:** The modal search field appears to have a blue active border, suggesting it is auto-focused when the modal opens, enabling immediate keyboard typing to filter collaborators.

10. **"View campaign email" link behavior:** [INFERRED] Clicking this likely opens a read-only modal or flyout showing the full HTML render of the campaign email, with metadata (subject line, sent time, from, to, open events). The URL format suggests these are campaign-level emails tracked at the system level.
